name: Exp_CoeffofLine_true
summary: This EA trades based on the CoeffofLine_true custom indicator, which measures the coefficient of a linear regression line to determine market momentum direction. It opens buy positions when the indicator crosses from negative to positive territory and sell positions when it crosses from positive to negative, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于CoeffofLine_true自定义指标进行交易，该指标通过线性回归系数判断市场动量方向。当指标从负值穿越到正值时开多仓，从正值穿越到负值时开空仓，并配有可配置的止损止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 该EA使用CoeffofLine_true指标作为核心策略信号，该指标基于线性回归系数衡量价格趋势的强度和方向。入场条件为：当指标值从负转正（Value[1]>0且Value[0]<0的穿越确认）时买入，当指标值从正转负（Value[1]<0且Value[0]>0的穿越确认）时卖出。出场条件包括：止损和止盈固定点数平仓，以及反向信号平仓（多仓在卖出信号时平仓，空仓在买入信号时平仓）。仓位管理通过MM参数实现，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的函数实现，包括BuyPositionOpen、SellPositionOpen等。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复交易，同时通过SignalBar参数允许在当前K线上即时响应信号。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the CoeffofLine_true indicator as its core strategy signal, which measures the strength and direction of price trends based on the linear regression coefficient. Entry conditions are: buy when the indicator crosses from negative to positive (Value[1]>0 and Value[0]<0 crossover confirmation), and sell when the indicator crosses from positive to negative (Value[1]<0 and Value[0]>0 crossover confirmation). Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit levels, as well as reverse signal exits (long positions close on sell signals, short positions close on buy signals). Position sizing is controlled through the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit percentage-based sizing. Money management relies on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions including BuyPositionOpen and SellPositionOpen. The EA uses an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate trades, while the SignalBar parameter allows immediate signal response on the current bar when set to zero.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款比例或固定手数，负值为固定手数
parameters.description_en: Trade fraction or fixed lot; negative value = lots

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description_en: Max price slippage deviation in points

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 使用新K线检测机制，避免同一K线内重复开仓，减少过度交易风险
支持买入和卖出的独立开关控制，灵活性高，可单独测试多头或空头策略
配有固定止损止盈，风险敞口有上限，不会出现无限亏损的情况
使用线性回归系数判断动量，比简单均线交叉更具统计学意义
pros_en: New bar detection mechanism prevents duplicate trades within the same bar, reducing overtrading risk
Independent buy/sell permission switches provide high flexibility for directional strategy testing
Fixed stop loss and take profit cap risk exposure, preventing unlimited losses
Linear regression coefficient for momentum assessment provides stronger statistical significance than simple MA crossovers
cons: 依赖外部自定义指标CoeffofLine_true和TradeAlgorithms.mqh库，缺少独立性和可移植性
止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值过大，对大多数品种而言风险收益比不合理
没有点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能频繁触发虚假信号导致亏损
缺乏多重时间框架确认，单一指标信号容易产生假突破
仓位管理参数MM设计反直觉，负值表示固定手数容易造成误用
cons_en: Depends on external custom indicator CoeffofLine_true and TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, lacking portability and self-containment
Default stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are excessively large, creating unreasonable risk-reward for most instruments
No spread filter means the EA may trigger false signals in high-spread environments leading to losses
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation, single indicator signals are prone to false breakouts
MM parameter design is counterintuitive, negative values for fixed lots can easily cause misuse
improvements: 添加点差过滤器，当点差超过阈值时暂停开仓，避免滑点过大造成的亏损
增加多时间框架确认机制，如大周期趋势方向一致时才开仓，提高信号可靠性
优化MM参数设计，使用枚举类型区分固定手数和比例模式，避免负值混淆
improvements_en: Add a spread filter to pause opening positions when spread exceeds a threshold, avoiding excessive slippage losses
Add multi-timeframe confirmation, only opening positions when the higher timeframe trend aligns, improving signal reliability
Redesign the MM parameter using an enum to distinguish between fixed lot and percentage modes, eliminating negative value confusion

risk_points: 默认止损1000点过大，可能在极端行情中造成重大亏损
没有点差过滤和保证金检查，存在在高成本环境下开仓的风险
依赖外部库和指标，若加载失败则无法正常交易
risk_points_en: Default 1000-point stop loss is excessively large, potentially causing significant losses in extreme market conditions
No spread filter or margin check poses risk of opening positions in high-cost environments
Dependency on external library and indicator means trading failure if they fail to load

It opens buy positions when the indicator crosses from negative to positive territory and sell positions when it crosses from positive to negative, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
